arStrings.szText:
While you have active {c_important}Minions{/c}, your {c_important}Summons{/c} deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_2|%x|]{/c} increased damage, but each {c_important}Minion{/c} Drains {c_number}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} Essence from you per second. 

While you have no active {c_important}Minions{/c}, you deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_2|%x|]{/c} increased damage, but {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} Essence Drains per second.
